prose: Tencent announced Hy4, its latest large model, which it says ranks among leading open-source models. Weights and system cards come in the coming days, with a focus on cyber and bio safety. New: visual understanding (image processing, charts, math reasoning), better instruction following and long context, stronger long-horizon agent tasks, and first-time computer use across command lines and GUIs. Rankings are Tencent's claim.
highlights: Hy4 adds vision and computer use for the first time
Weights and system cards promised within days
